articles.headline: Western Sydney Wanderers decry policing at A-League games: 'Enough is enough'
articles.description: Western Sydney Wanderers chair Paul Lederer has hit out at what he has said is "totally unacceptable" policing of his club's supporters, labelling it excessive and declaring that "enough is enough."

images.name: Valadon scores his first A-League goal for Victory
images.caption: Jordi Valadon levels the scores for 10-men Melbourne, firing home an absolute ROCKET from outside the box.

articles.headline: A-League Men Stocks: The Nix nobody saw coming
articles.description: The Phoenix are the A-League's only perfect team, the Jets are searching for answers, and Victory's Valadon scores a stunner -- all that and more in ESPN's Stocks Up, Stocks Down.

images.name: Awer Mabil scores the match winner for Melbourne City
images.caption: For the first time in over 11 years, Awer Mabil has scored an A-League goal, sealing the victory over Sydney FC.

articles.headline: A-Leagues' financial woes: How solvent is Australia's top tier?
articles.description: Unbundling from Football Australia was supposed to herald a new dawn for soccer Down Under. Instead, an ESPN investigation asks: are the A-Leagues at risk of collapse?

images.caption: Fox Sports ended its 16-year association with the A-Leagues in 2021.

images.caption: The COVID-19 pandemic was a body blow that the A-Leagues are still trying to recover from.
